title: Reviewing AI-Generated Code
description: Reading AI output for correctness, security, and maintainability — the skill that matters more than typing speed once AI writes the first draft.

title: Correctness, Security Depth, and Reading Under Pressure
description: The bugs the happy path hides — races, retries, N+1s, missing authorization, unsafe deserialization — and the triage skill for reviewing a large diff without the energy to read every line.

title: Maintainability and the Review You Ship
description: Abstractions built for one caller, logic that will drift, comments that outrun the code — and turning judgment into a review a colleague can actually act on.
